label: POST-V2 EXTENSION; Conv1-all-64 BoardSimulator; frozen before any extension measurement
frozen_at: 2026-10-08 before any extension measurements; remote BoardSimulator run
status: FINAL FROZEN; not a draft; no measurement has run under this protocol
scope: BoardSimulator only; frozen seed0 Paper1 checkpoint, Conv1 filters 0..63; no physical board, no official test set, no hybrid checkpoints, no training/STDP jobs
weights_loading: Conv1 weights pre-extracted locally (torch-gpu) from the frozen checkpoint into conv1_weights.npy float32 [64,3,5,5]; remote/extension loads via numpy ONLY (np.load), never torch.load/weights_only
tap_order: channel-major 3x5x5 flattened 75; tiles [0,32),[32,64),[64,75); two positive-conductance columns per fresh 32x8 array
array_seed_formula: 50000 + 100000*filter + 1000*replicate + 101*tile; 576 distinct fresh seeds, disjoint from v2 seeds 27001-27003 (v2 reused no longer); no seed reused
advance: pilot gate before small; small before medium; medium before remaining; explicit parent stage authorization each time; no retry/tuning after any gate failure
mapping: Target G+=.03+.02*w/maxabs75, G-=.03-.02*w/maxabs75 on 32x8 BoardSimulator, 2 columns per tile; input x (binary) -> requested v=.3*x, and v (NOT x) passed to core.dot_product; DAC-decoded voltages used for quantized prediction; analog/readback reconstruction (col0-col1)*maxabs75/(.04*.3)
safety: Before every MVM: reject requested and decoded >.3V without clipping; check observed and actual resistances finite positive; predicted sum(decoded_V/R) positive column for BOTH views strictly <.015A before HardCore.dot_product and BoardSimulator.mode_mvm; abort ADC zero with nonzero input or >=2**adc_bit-1. No physical board or test set. Programming pulses separate from inference limit.
surrogate: Fit y_ideal=intercept+slope*y_sim_mvm by least squares using only train patch outputs per replicate, fixed on held-out val; report raw and fitted correlation/RMSE, no sigma substitution
